name: minikube
description: Local Kubernetes cluster for development and testing with multiple driver support

tools.description: Run Kubernetes clusters locally for development with various virtualization drivers
tools.usage:
minikube start # Start local Kubernetes cluster
minikube status # Show cluster status
minikube dashboard # Open Kubernetes dashboard
minikube docker-env # Configure Docker to use minikube
minikube stop # Stop the cluster
minikube delete # Delete cluster
